image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is positioned diagonally across a forest floor covered in wet brown leaves, moss, and pine needles. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the limbs are short and visible against the dark background.
